instrumentation_limitations: No execution was performed, so no proof, gate, test or build result in this repository is confirmed by this phase. Every count attributed to a proof run is reported as the repository's own record of it, and where such a record contradicts the committed code that is recorded as a defect (DEF-04).
The Windows development platform cannot exercise the capture boundary at all: capture.py requires openat2 and refuses on any other kernel (DEF-23).
The historical DeepSeek turnstore (1.36 GB sqlite) was not opened; admission rested on the sealed manifest root, which matched.

No new instrument, runner or framework was built. Total instrument-building budget spent: zero, as instructed. The only scripts written were a path classifier, a citation resolver and these deliverable generators, all of which are analysis of git objects and none of which is a system component.
